turns.rephrase: I mean: find the calls scheduled at 8.
I mean: pick the first of them.
I mean: get the person it is with.

turns.gold:
PROCEDURE person_on_call_at(time:TIME)
$v0 = FIND CALL WHERE PARENT.WHEN={time}
$v1 = FIRST $v0
$v2 = GET $v1 WHO
RETURN $v2
END
turns.name: person_on_call_at

turns.rephrase: I mean: find all calls with Trent.
I mean: count how many there are.

turns.gold:
PROCEDURE count_calls_with(person:PERSON)
$v0 = FIND CALL WHERE SELF.WHO={person}
$v1 = COUNT $v0
RETURN $v1
END
turns.name: count_calls_with

turns.text: REQUEST count calls with whoever is on the 1 call

turns.gold:
PROCEDURE count_calls_for_time_person(time:TIME)
$v0 = CALL person_on_call_at time={time}
$v1 = CALL count_calls_with person=$v0
RETURN $v1
END
turns.name: count_calls_for_time_person
